Changes.note: The time you choose is written to the session and to the audit log; it belongs to the session, not to its recording, and stays when the recording changes. Until then talebe and outside viewers see the recording but cannot watch it; the course team watches it at once. If the recording is ready and nobody was told before, the enrolled talebe get one “Kayıt eklendi” notification when it opens to them: at once with “Hazır olunca hemen”, at the time when you chose one. You may change the time as often as you like; a notification that went out cannot be taken back and is not sent again.
